onepager: 31. Patient Intake and Scheduling Agent one-pager.pptx

promises.advertised_promise: Verify insurance, referrals, and network status during patient intake
synthetic_evidence: Summarizes present and missing synthetic intake evidence for staff confirmation.
Coverage evidence is transcribed; live eligibility, referral, and network determinations remain in approved source systems.

promises.advertised_promise: Deliver tailored digital packets with all required pre-visit forms
synthetic_evidence: Transcribes source-recorded synthetic coverage evidence without determining eligibility.
The agent produces a missing-item inventory but does not deliver packets or write records.

promises.advertised_promise: Automate reminders across multiple scheduled touchpoints
synthetic_evidence: Shows candidate synthetic source slots without holding, booking, or changing an appointment.
Reminder schedules are recommended drafts computed from the slot; no outbound communication or scheduling mutation is configured.

promises.advertised_promise: Ensure clinicians’ availability and readiness through up-to-date scheduling data
synthetic_evidence: Drafts a minimum-necessary readiness handoff for authorized patient-access review.
Candidate synthetic source slots are displayed without booking or freshness claims.
